messages:
Jordan: heads up — main pipeline just flipped red after merge 0a1b2c3 (PR #9876). Failing step: integrations/smoke-test (timeout at 00:12). Logs: https://ci.redwood/123/logs/456 :rotating_light: Anyone oncall?

ci-bot: Build 12345 failed on step integrations/smoke-test. Triggered by merge 0a1b2c3. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/123/artifacts. Rerun command: `./scripts/ci rerun --job=integrations/smoke-test --build=12345`

Maya: I touched the smoke test seed handling in that PR (small fix). Could be flaky. @Sam can you rerun? I can revert if it's consistently failing.

Sam: taking. Running rerun now. Command: `./scripts/ci rerun --job=integrations/smoke-test --build=12345 --parallel=1`

Alex: assigning first-responder to @Sam per rotation :eyes:

Sam: rerun started — https://ci.redwood/123/rerun/1 ... rerun finished — still failing, same timeout at 00:12. Attaching tail of log:
```text
[2026-03-18T14:12:05Z] ERROR: TestHarness timed out waiting for model to load
```

Jordan: that matches my local repro on a small node. Could be a race introduced by the seed change.

Maya: quick diff from my PR: changed Random.seed -> Random.reset between tests. If the test expects deterministic order, that could delay initialization.

Sam: can we bisect to the commit? If it's the PR, we can revert. Running bisect against main now: `git bisect start --bad main --good main~5`

ci-bot: Notifying PR author @Maya and merge author @Jordan. Suspected PR: #9876

Maya: thanks. I'll standby and prepare a revert if needed.

Sam: bisect points to commit 0a1b2c3 (the PR). I can file a quick revert now unless someone objects.

Jordan: please revert, we need the pipeline green. I'll open a revert PR and tag @release for fast-merge.

Maya: ack — I'll follow up with a proper fix and test addition.

Sam: reverted. CI rerun queued. Will update when green. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/reverts/54321 — rerun queued (build 12346).

Sam: build 12346 finished — all smoke tests passed. Closing loop, will add a test for seed handling in a follow-up.

Jordan: thanks all. Filing postmortem note in #incidents later.
